security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://127.0.0.1:11434; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'none';

bundle.shortDescription: Offline-first robotics learning and simulation studio
bundle.longDescription: RoboForge is a free, open-source, offline-first desktop app that teaches robotics with interactive circuit, Arduino, and 2D mobile robot physics simulators alongside a local Socratic AI coach.
